Under AMEND-12 discipline, publication requires at minimum the HIGH subset to be individually verified against physical edition; the MEDIUM subset should be batch-verified before reaching §2; the LOW subset should be withdrawn from primary analysis and held for sensitivity-only.

# Bonferroni note: this supplement adds k=1 additional test to AMEND-13's k=3 (pooled + K-stratum + B-stratum). Revised Bonferroni for the full 40+23=63-site test would be k=4 at α=0.0125 each. If the 23-site subset is analyzed separately as a replication-on-disjoint-data test, k=2 at α=0.025 each (40-site primary + 23-site replication) is the more interpretable decomposition.

# Critical caveat: this 23-site list exhausts classical-scholar's working-notes recall of mid-surah ʿadd dispute sites. It is NOT claimed to be "the remaining ~23 of ~63." The al-Dānī Bayān reports ~60-75 dispute sites total depending on how one counts overlapping disputes; the 40+23=63 total hit by AMEND-13 + this supplement is an approximate coverage, not a claim of completeness. If computational-tester finds a dispute site al-Dānī documents that neither list covers, this is expected and should be logged as a classical-scholar catalog gap, not treated as adversarial.
